text:
```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Code for Issue Triage
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are an expert triage assistant for the anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python repository.
            
            Analyze the issue provided in the context. Determine the most appropriate labels to apply based on the content of the issue.
            
            Available labels include:
            - bug: Something isn't working
            - documentation: Improvements or additions to documentation
            - enhancement: New feature or request
            - question: Further information is requested
            - good first issue: Good for newcomers
            - help wanted: Extra attention is needed
            
            Use the GitHub MCP server to apply the determined labels to the current issue.
            Do not modify the issue body or close the issue. Only add labels.
          allowed_tools: |
            mcp__github__add_labels_to_an_issue
            mcp__github__get_issue
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
```
